gates.evidence: The proposal features Starship Galley, a sci-fi comedy cooking character, which is safe and age-appropriate.
The reward grants in-app credits (r1) for completing a 15-second mini-game play, with no incentives for clicks, installs, ratings, or cash.
The offer uses clean gain framing with Play Now and No Thanks buttons, avoiding dark patterns.
Users explicitly tap the character quest banner on the mode selection sheet to initiate the offer.
The offer clearly states Play a quick 15-second game with Starship Galley to earn free credits and +10 credits before launch.
Declining via No Thanks leaves the user exactly where they were with no penalty.
The offer is triggered from the chat mode sheet rather than interrupting an active AI message stream.
Eligibility is explicitly restricted to non-paying guest users.

scores.evidence: Placed on the mode selection sheet where users review credit costs per message, providing proactive credit earning.
Uses Simula SIM-RWD unit with an in-world game partner (Starship Galley), though minor grounding errors exist in patch/storyboard element references.
Restricted to non-paying users, capped at 3 per day (30 credits total, worth ~$0.04), well below the cheapest $1.39 credit pack.
Cost to serve per view ($0.0018) is well under 30% of US net revenue per view ($0.009–0.015), and reward value aligns safely with view earnings.
Triggered from the mode selection sheet (s04), which has rare/occasional reach compared to active chat or home feed.
Maps directly to SIM-RWD SDK specifications, but requires fixing patch element ne1 grounding and storyboard node e3 references.
Utilizes specific app nouns such as currency r1 (credits), character Starship Galley, and Choose Chat Mode sheet s04.
Explicitly caps offers at 3 per day with a 60-minute cooldown.
Defines primary metrics (Rewarded ARPDAU, D7 retention), guardrails (-3% paid conversion non-inferiority), and a 90/10 user holdout.
